text: In the Lab 13 DeepESN (3 layers of 100 neurons), what leak rates are assigned to layers 1, 2, and 3?
explanation: The lab sets LEAK_RATES = [1.0, 0.3, 0.1], so the leak rate DECREASES with depth: the fast bottom layer forgets quickly, the slow top layer integrates over a long window. Option 0 reverses the order; option 1 (equal rates) would collapse the hierarchy back to shallow behavior; option 3 lists the spectral radii SPEC_RADII = [0.9, 0.95, 0.99], not the leak rates.
